emma_cs: Quick heads-up: Lumenix queued a surprise embeddings job spike ahead of renewal, need QBR-ready triage.
lia_fin: Numbers? project the delta vs commit.
billing-bot: [auto] account=Lumenix | 7d_tokens=2,010,340 | projected_30d=8,632,560 | commit=3,000,000 | alert=over_commit
emma_cs: Pattern: recurring ingestion every 6h started ~9 days ago. Likely a scheduled pipeline.
rahul_se: I'll reach infra and book a 20-min triage. Propose: short-term quota, immediate batching, and a canary to quantify quality impact of quantized embeddings.
maria_enablement: Ill assemble a one-pager playbook: caching, dedupe, batch config, recommended model variants, and a 10-step runbook they can follow.
devon_ops: From ops: we can deploy edge rate-limits and move non-critical jobs to off-peak windows; sample nginx snippet attached.
jon_eng: (OOO) devon will capture technical snippets. Include KV prefix caching and batching knobs in examples.
lia_fin: Two scenarios for QBR: 
A) 35% reduction via batching+cache -> projected=5,611,164 tokens (over commit ~2.6M)
B) 65% reduction via batching+quantization+gating -> projected=3,021,396 tokens (~within commit)
lia_fin: Ill produce $ deltas and a conservative renewal-risk blurb if unmitigated.
rahul_se: Monitoring triggers to include in playbook: sustained rate > 2x baseline for 1h, similarity_drop>3%, error_rate>1%.
maria_enablement: Uploaded draft: https://drive.internal/r/enablement/lumenix-embed-playbook. Will add canary checklist and rollback thresholds.
billing-bot: [auto] created_alert account=Lumenix type=high_projection severity=warning channel=#customer-success
emma_cs: Owners: rahul (customer outreach + meeting), devon (tech snippets), maria (playbook), lia (cost slides). Lia needs numbers by Tue EOD for deck.ahul_se: Invite sent for Tue 11am.
lia_fin: Will prepare conservative & optimistic slide variants; send to me by Tue EOD.
emma_cs: Great. Short updates only; Ill consolidate for the exec deck after the call. :thumbsup:
